description: Documented non-executor interpreter invocations the R5 rule permits. One shared data file, read by both the OpenCode guard plugin (.opencode/plugin/guard.js) and the Claude PreToolUse hook (claude_pretooluse_hook.py). 'entries' are REPOSITORY-RELATIVE paths, matched EXACTLY against the invocation's script path resolved against the repository root. 'bundle_entries' are BUNDLE-RELATIVE paths (nested-layout spelling, e.g. skills/{skill}/scripts/x.py): an invocation is admitted when its RESOLVED script path equals '{deployed bundle root}/{bundle-relative entry}', where the deployed bundle root comes from the platform-runtime bundle-cache layout (the Claude plugin cache nested layout and the flat OpenCode / Antigravity skill roots). Both forms are matched EXACTLY: never a basename, never a suffix, never a bare cache prefix, so a copy of an allow-listed script outside the repository or outside a deployed bundle never matches. Each entry cites its documenting line.
